caption: The drawing depicts three views of a green glass bottle, rendered in a realistic style. The largest, central view shows the front of the bottle, which is oval in shape with a short neck and a wide body, and it features an embossed design of an eagle with outstretched wings, clutching an olive branch and arrows, with rays emanating from its head. Below the eagle, there is an embossed oval medallion with the letters "T.W.D" inscribed inside. The bottle is shaded in various tones of green, highlighting its translucent and reflective glass surface. In the upper left corner, a smaller view displays the reverse side of the bottle, featuring a different design with a starburst pattern, a motif that appears to be a cornucopia or horn of plenty, and other ornamental details. The upper right corner presents the bottle in profile, emphasizing its narrow and ribbed side, with the embossing visible as raised patterns. The drawing is set on a cream-colored background within a lightly pencilled rectangular border.
title: Flask
